content:
# New ACK-Managed S3 Logs Bucket

Based on the bare Kubernetes manifest setup with independent `dev/` and `prod/` directories, here are the manifests to add logs bucket support with proper ACK resources and IAM grants:

`dev/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-dev
spec:
  bucketName: myapp-logs-dev
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`dev/iam.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: User
metadata:
  name: myapp-service-user
spec:
  userName: myapp-service-user-dev
  inlinePolicies:
  - name: myapp-assets-access-dev
    document: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject",
              "s3:ListBucket"
            ],
            "Resource": [
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-assets-dev",
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-assets-dev/*"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
  - name: myapp-logs-access-dev
    document: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject",
              "s3:PutObject"
            ],
            "Resource": [
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
```

`prod/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-prod
spec:
  bucketName: myapp-logs-prod
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`prod/iam.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-service-role
spec:
  roleName: myapp-service-role-prod
  assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Principal": {
            "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B716D3041E"
          },
          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
          "Condition": {
            "StringEquals": {
              "oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B716D3041E:sub": "system:serviceaccount:default:myapp"
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  inlinePolicies:
  - name: myapp-assets-access-prod
    document: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject",
              "s3:ListBucket"
            ],
            "Resource": [
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-assets-prod",
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-assets-prod/*"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
  - name: myapp-logs-access-prod
    document: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject",
              "s3:PutObject"
            ],
            "Resource": [
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod/*"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
```

## Summary

- **Buckets**: New `logs-bucket.yaml` in each env with versioning, AES256 encryption, and public access fully blocked
- **Permissions**: Updated `iam.yaml` in each env to add separate inline policies for logs access only (distinct from existing assets access)
- **Isolation**: Dev and prod remain fully independent — changes to one do not affect the other
- **Least privilege**: Logs policies grant only `s3:GetObject` and `s3:PutObject` on their respective logs buckets; assets bucket access unchanged
